📰 General

Idaho Lawmakers Approve Controversial Bathroom Bill Targeting Gender Identity •

Idaho’s legislature has passed a bill that would penalize individuals using restrooms not corresponding to their sex assigned at birth. The legislation applies to government-owned buildings and public accommodations, potentially criminalizing the use of facilities by transgender and non-binary individuals. Supporters argue the bill protects privacy and safety, while opponents express concerns about discrimination and potential legal challenges. The bill now awaits the governor’s signature to become law.

🌍 World

Iran Announces Tolls on Strait of Hormuz, Raising Shipping Concerns •

Iranian lawmakers are advancing legislation to implement fees for vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway for global trade. The move follows a period where Iranian authorities have significantly reduced ship traffic through the strait. The proposed tolls aim to generate revenue for Iran while simultaneously restricting access to the Persian Gulf. This action has raised concerns among international shipping companies regarding potential disruptions to global supply chains. The legislation is currently under review within the Iranian Parliament.

🦅 US

Mexico Launches Search for Sailboats Carrying Aid to Cuba Amidst Storms •

Mexican authorities initiated a search and rescue operation following the disappearance of two sailboats en route to Cuba. The vessels were carrying humanitarian aid, including food and medicine, intended for the island nation. Strong storms in the Gulf of Mexico are believed to be a contributing factor to the vessels’ vanishing. Nine individuals were aboard the boats at the time of their disappearance, and the search is ongoing.

💰 Business

Amazon’s Big Spring Sale Continues with Deep Discounts on Home Goods •

The Amazon Big Spring Sale is ongoing, offering significant reductions on a wide range of household items. The sale currently features substantial discounts on bedding, including sheets, towels, and pillows. Retailers are providing deals across various categories of home goods. Consumers are taking advantage of the sale to purchase items such as appliances and kitchenware.

💻 Technology

Viral Mac App Lets Users “Moan” When They Slap Their Laptops •

A new Mac application has rapidly gained popularity after its creator reported earning over $5,000 within three days of its release. The app simulates a “moaning” sound when a user physically taps or slaps their laptop. The developer, who goes by the handle “SlickSteve,” initially created the app as a joke. The app’s unexpected success highlights the appeal of novelty and humorous applications within the Mac ecosystem.

🎭 Entertainment

Glen Powell Stars as Fox McCloud in New Super Mario Galaxy Movie •

Actor Glen Powell has officially joined the cast of “The Super Mario Galaxy Movie,” confirming his role as Fox McCloud. Powell shared the news via an Instagram post alongside a promotional video for the film. The movie is a Super Mario-themed project, and Powell’s involvement adds a notable comedic element to the animated adventure. Production on the film is currently underway, with a release date yet to be announced.

🏅 Sports

NBA Owners Presented Three Anti-Tanking Proposals, Expanding Draft Lottery •

The NBA presented three distinct proposals to its owners aimed at reducing teams’ incentive to intentionally lose games, known as tanking. Each proposal would increase the size of the annual Draft Lottery, expanding it to include between 18 and 22 teams. These changes would significantly alter the selection process, potentially elevating lower-performing teams into contention for higher draft picks. The proposals focus on expanding opportunities for teams aiming to compete in the play-in or playoff rounds. The league is seeking to create a more competitive environment across the entire NBA.

🔬 Science

NASA’s Artemis II Crew: A Diverse Team Preparing for Historic Moon Voyage •

The Artemis II mission, slated for launch in 2026, will feature a four-person crew representing significant advancements in space exploration. This mission marks the first human lunar landing attempt in over 50 years and includes the first woman and the first person of color to travel to the moon. The crew also comprises the first Canadian astronaut to undertake this journey. NASA is leading this initiative, aiming to establish a sustainable human presence beyond Earth’s orbit.

🩺 Health

New Study Links Gut Bacteria to Increased Risk of Alzheimer’s Disease •

Researchers have identified a specific bacterial composition in the gut that correlates with an elevated risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease. The study, published in Alzheimer’s & Dementia, examined the gut microbiome of individuals with and without the disease. Participants with a higher abundance of certain bacteria were found to have increased levels of inflammatory markers in their blood. This suggests a potential link between gut health and the progression of Alzheimer’s disease, warranting further investigation.
